title: A Fixed-Backbone Exclusion for Length-70 Binary (9,1) Covering Sequences
supported_claim: For the explicit 64-edge backbone, every connected nonnegative integral circulation of total mass 70 has overlap at most 61, and no valid binary radius-1 covering sequence attains overlap 61. Every valid length-70 cover therefore has backbone overlap at most 60.
external_review_status: Invited; no external mathematical review is claimed.
scope: A complete theorem for one explicit backbone at exact length 70. It is not a new construction, a new bound on L(9,1), or a global impossibility result.
